info.title: Neon Self-hosted Functions Public HTTP Preview

origin.description: Operator-owned separate Functions origin; explicit laboratory HTTP exception

get.summary: Raw application HTTP/SSE on the separate Functions origin
get.description: Public opt-in only. Application authentication/CORS is the handler responsibility. Control cookies, Set-Cookie and proxy/platform headers are excluded. This listener never serves Console API. No automatic invocation replay; 502 can mean unknown execution outcome. Fifteen-minute request bound; no WebSocket.

200.description: Original application response (other application statuses are also forwarded)

422.description: Invalid method/path/header rejected before cold wake

502.description: Dispatch outcome unknown; do not replay automatically

503.description: No dispatch: disabled, manual suspension, revoked owner, quota, cold-wake deadline or admission busy

default.description: Original application HTTP status, headers and body
